revisions.statement: The standard firmware boots in stable Xbox mode without ROS2. Actual CRC-valid UART presence enables the explicit Down+B five-second navigation gesture. Idle ROS2 presence runs on an independent 20ms wall timer, without requiring odometry/camera. After 150ms without valid traffic, navigation falls back to stable fresh-Xbox control; reconnect never automatically resumes navigation. Compile-time standalone rejects all companion frames. Physical BLE/UART wiring and timing remain unvalidated.

revisions.statement: Gentle simulation input uses squared sticks after deadband, 5-degree roll/pitch limits, 0.5m/s vertical and 45deg/s yaw requests, and reduced triggers. Normal remains available; full Down-LT disarm is preserved. This is not horizontal speed/position hold. Physical firmware gains and limits are unchanged.

revisions.statement: Gentle is now also the physical C firmware default: squared axes, 5deg roll/pitch, .5m/s base vertical and45dps yaw. Simulation explicitly shapes once and tests C/UI equivalence. RT/LT retain full travel; allocator collective ceiling ranges .5..8 with neutral .65. 1800 microseconds is only a provisional normalized pulse equivalent; individual differential motor corrections may use the remaining .2 range. Physical outputs disabled.
revisions.reason: User requested default Gentle, full RT/LT with PID headroom and extensive FC/ROS2 debugging, profiling and tests.

revisions.statement: ROS2 uses intended path velocity for yaw and holds heading near waypoints/landing. Same five-node before/after simulated cases passed; yaw travel decreased 57.03% and yaw-rate RMS 39.53%. This single-case comparison does not characterize hardware or all layouts. A separate 15fps five-node run passed.

The analysis tool scans every native frame, enables frame stepping, exports graph means/min/max and evaluates navigation separately from later manual collisions. Off-origin reset and a ROS-free 15fps recording were verified.

revisions.statement: Two isolated seven-node native Gazebo/ROS2/C-host trials completed with five intermediate acknowledgements each, zero obstacle contact steps, and final XY errors 8.14mm and 16.76mm. One PC route request was followed only by neutral HID; the onboard mission node was the sole companion publisher. A start inside newly enlarged soft clearance is allowed to exit outward outside the observed obstacle plus aircraft radius, failed plans retry and expose reasons. Perfect simulated localization, synthetic sensors and known-panel PnP remain explicit simplifications. Deliberately removing UART at 25s prevented completion and produced stale companion status and horizontal drift; this is not safe position hold.
revisions.reason: Requested multi-node fault diagnosis, actual command-authority tests and next-start settings/recording UI; original prior trials retained.

revisions.statement: Final native Gazebo C/ROS2 route completed89.04 simulated seconds, intermediate indices1..5 and zero panel contacts. Original wire audit shows onePC route, neutral HID thereafter, sole onboard companion publisher, valid CRC/finite setpoints and noPC pose/image subscription. Dropping companion frames after25s prevents completion and FC marks link stale. Ideal localization/known-panel PnP/synthetic sensors remain explicit.
revisions.reason: User requested default Gentle, full RT/LT with PID headroom and extensive FC/ROS2 debugging, profiling and tests.

revisions.statement: A 45-second interval of the user's real recorded Xbox input was replayed unchanged through standalone C FC/native Gazebo, with no ROS2, no companion frames and no feedback pilot. All 1993 non-PC-gesture rows exactly matched documented stick shaping, and 2670 HID reports produced takeoff and horizontal motion. This was an open-loop input replay, not a new live human flight or landing success; substantial drift occurred. The earlier preflight-only replay is retained separately.
revisions.reason: Requested multi-node fault diagnosis, actual command-authority tests and next-start settings/recording UI; original prior trials retained.

revisions.statement: Manual roll/pitch still command angle. With fresh explicit horizontal localization, the C FC captures the release point, brakes with bounded counter-tilt then holds XY; yaw decoding is reversed. Sustained-angle testing found false accelerometer gravity correction during translation; skipping that correction during measured manual acceleration while preserving gyro prediction/covariance changed 4-second 5deg requests from failed means 12.26/14.70deg to 5.059/5.066deg. Final long test settled within 3.12cm with <0.019m/s residual speed; short test within 5.18cm. No-localization control failed position hold as expected. This uses perfect simulated position/velocity/yaw as a sensor input; no real localization driver, IMU-only horizontal hold or physical flight validation is claimed. Six existing PID loops plus two optional outer XY PD corrections remain in the single C runtime. Navigation regression completed all nodes with no panel contacts.
revisions.reason: User requested true manual angle behavior, braking/hold on release, reversed yaw, and automatic recording/new-tab/end-close lifecycle; original failures retained.

Automatic 15fps fragmented MP4 and telemetry journals save alongside original 500Hz CSV and raw inputs. A saved 0.65m/s setting left the active 0.8m/s run unchanged and was observed in the next ROS2 startup log; defaults were restored. UI validation used a disconnected Xbox and is not a manual flight claim.
revisions.reason: Requested multi-node fault diagnosis, actual command-authority tests and next-start settings/recording UI; original prior trials retained.

A manually opened tab may require manual closing under browser policy. Current guide and plots expose ideal localization and gravity-observation gating.
